user.title: Set up Reorder
user.description: Configure Reorder shopping-list routing. Orders are queued locally until explicitly submitted.

init.title: Manage Reorder
init.description: Choose what you want to manage. Products are matched against the Home Assistant shopping list.

menu_option_descriptions.add_product: Choose a shopping-list name, exact product, quantity, and up to two substitutes.
menu_option_descriptions.edit_product: Change products already approved for Reorder.
menu_option_descriptions.remove_product: Delete an approved product from the catalog.
menu_option_descriptions.zinc_settings: Set Zinc credentials, test/live behavior, and delivery address.

add_product.title: Add reorder product
add_product.description: Set what Reorder should match and queue. Saving this product does not place an order.

data.name: Product name
data.product_id: Preferred product URL or retailer ID

data_description.name: Exact Shopping List name to match, ignoring case and extra spaces. Names with order history stay fixed; use aliases for new matching names.
data_description.aliases: Alternative shopping-list names, separated by commas. For example: coffee beans, ground coffee.
data_description.retailer: Zinc supports purchasing. Kroger and Other are catalog placeholders in this release.
data_description.product_id: For Zinc, enter the full retailer product URL. For Kroger, use the product identifier/UPC.
data_description.substitute_1: Optional approved HTTPS alternative. Only the standalone out-of-stock workflow can queue it; batches never switch products automatically.
data_description.substitute_2: Second optional alternative for that manual standalone workflow. Saving it does not order a replacement.
data_description.quantity: Fixed retailer units for each matching list entry. Shopping List text does not change this quantity. Check the retailer pack size before ordering.
data_description.max_price: USD allowance for the configured quantity, including tax and shipping. Batch submission adds these allowances into one total cap; Zinc does not enforce a separate cap per product line. This is not a price quote.
data_description.cooldown_hours: Blocks repeat requests. Confirmed delivery or recorded receipt starts the cooldown from its first observation; pending or uncertain purchases remain blocked. 168 hours = 7 days.
data_description.enabled: Turn off to stop Reorder from matching this catalog entry.

data_description.product: Select the approved catalog item you want to change.

zinc_settings.title: Zinc settings
zinc_settings.description: Sandbox uses zn_test_ credentials and simulated orders. Live uses zn_live_ credentials and can spend real money only after live purchasing is enabled and an action is explicitly confirmed. The sidebar submits Sandbox batches only. Changing keys does not convert or cancel saved orders.

data_description.zinc_api_key: Choose the intended Zinc account and environment. Only records matching the current key environment can refresh. Read-only batch tracking continues with a live key even when live purchasing is off. Never share this key.
data_description.zinc_live_enabled: Allows native live submission with the exact phrase PLACE LIVE ORDER. It does not submit anything, enable scheduled purchasing, or add a live submit button to the sidebar. Turn off again after the trial to prevent new live submissions.

batch_settings.title: Batching schedule
batch_settings.description: Schedules prepare local batches for review; they never purchase. Status tracking and delivery completion are separate. Manage source synchronization and automatic delivery completion on the Reorder sidebar Settings page. Monday=0, Sunday=6; times use Home Assistant local time.

data_description.strategy: Manual requires you to prepare batches; weekly and rolling only mark batches ready.
data_description.weekday: Only used for weekly schedule. Sunday=6.
data_description.hour: Only used for weekly schedule. 10 means 10:00 AM.
data_description.rolling_hours: Only used for rolling schedule, e.g. 48 means two days.
